statement: Pinned OpenPuck compatibility firmware describes an emulated Pro Controller with HID input 0x30/0x21/0x81, a synthetic report descriptor, USB 0x80 responses and 0x21 subcommand replies with matching initialization paths.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Device-role source evidence of an emulated compatibility device, NOT a retail Nintendo HID descriptor or a physical capture.
